diagnosis: RestoreSnapshotWorker applies a database snapshot directly by ID without asserting that both the target database and the snapshot belong to the same organization. An attacker can overwrite another tenant's database with an arbitrary snapshot or restore sensitive corporate snapshots into their own sandbox database.

corrected_code:
class RestoreSnapshotWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(database_id, snapshot_id)
    database = ManagedDatabase.find(database_id)
    snapshot = DatabaseSnapshot.find(snapshot_id)

    raise 'Tenant boundary violation' unless database.tenant_id == snapshot.tenant_id

    DatabaseRestorationService.apply!(database, snapshot)
  end
end

class DatabasesController < ApplicationController
  def restore
    db = current_tenant.managed_databases.find(params[:id])
    snap = current_tenant.database_snapshots.find(params[:snapshot_id])

    RestoreSnapshotWorker.perform_async(db.id, snap.id)
    render json: { message: 'Restoration scheduled' }
  end
end
